description: Wishlist of x402 services needed to ship the bundles in BUNDLES_NEEDING_NEW_ENDPOINTS.md. Same schema as services.json. Entries use status='hidden' to match the existing wishlist convention (e.g. sec-edgar). Endpoint URLs/methods are taken from each provider's public docs; pricing is null because the x402 wrap fee is TBD.

services.name: Polymarket
services.description: Prediction market data and order execution via the CLOB API.

endpoints.description: Place a buy/sell order on a market
List open and historical orders for a wallet

services.notes: Unlocks: Polymarket News Trader bundle (already mocked in endpoints/mock-bundles.ts). Native chain is Polygon; needs an x402 wrapper that bridges USDC on Base to Polygon settlement.

services.name: Kalshi
services.description: CFTC-regulated event contracts — markets, orders, positions.

endpoints.description: Submit an order on a Kalshi market

services.notes: Regulated US prediction markets. Required for the Polymarket-style bundle to also serve US-only users.

services.name: YouTube Data + Transcripts
services.description: Search videos, fetch metadata, retrieve auto/manual transcripts and captions.

endpoints.description: Get video metadata, statistics, content details
List and download captions for a video

services.notes: Unlocks: YouTube → Podcast bundle. Captions endpoint requires OAuth on the official API; an unofficial transcript fetcher (e.g. youtube-transcript-api) is the practical wrap target.

services.name: ElevenLabs
services.description: Premium TTS and voice cloning.

endpoints.description: Synthesize speech from text using a chosen voice
Clone a voice from sample audio
Auto-dub a video into another language

services.notes: Unlocks: Voice Cloning + Narration bundle. Deepgram TTS does not support cloning.

services.name: Alpaca
services.description: US equities + crypto brokerage — quotes, bars, and order execution.

endpoints.description: Submit an equity or crypto order (paper or live)

services.notes: Unlocks: Equities Trading Agent. Easiest brokerage to wrap — REST-first, paper trading available.

services.name: Interactive Brokers
services.description: Multi-asset brokerage — equities, options, futures, FX, bonds.

endpoints.description: Market data snapshot (requires Client Portal Gateway)

services.notes: Powerful but operationally heavy — requires Client Portal Gateway or TWS. Use Alpaca first; add IBKR for institutional users.

services.name: Polygon.io
services.description: Real-time and historical market data — stocks, options, forex, crypto, indices.

endpoints.description: OHLCV aggregate bars for a ticker
Real-time snapshot for a US stock

services.notes: Alpha-vantage alternative with better real-time depth. Good complement once alpha-vantage flips to live.

services.name: Financial Modeling Prep
services.description: Earnings calendar, corporate actions, financial statements, ratios.
services.notes: Fills the corporate-actions gap that Alpha Vantage and Polygon don't cover well.

services.name: SecurityTrails
services.description: WHOIS, passive DNS, subdomain discovery, historical DNS records.

endpoints.description: Domain details (current DNS, alexa rank, etc.)
All known subdomains for a hostname

services.notes: Unlocks: Threat Intelligence bundle (DNS recon).

services.name: NVD (National Vulnerability Database)
services.description: CVE lookup, CPE search, CVSS scoring.

endpoints.description: Search CVEs by keyword, CPE, severity, date

services.notes: Free upstream API — wrap fee covers infra + rate-limit pooling. Unlocks: Threat Intelligence bundle.

services.name: HubSpot
services.description: CRM — contacts, companies, deals, engagements, tickets.
services.notes: Highest-leverage CRM wrap. Required for CRM-Synced Sales Agent bundle.

services.name: Salesforce
services.description: Enterprise CRM — sObject CRUD, SOQL queries, Composite API.

endpoints.description: Composite request — multiple subrequests in one call

services.notes: Required for enterprise CRM bundle. OAuth + per-org instance URL makes wrapping non-trivial.

services.name: Pipedrive
services.description: Sales-focused CRM — deals, persons, organizations, activities.
services.notes: Lighter-weight CRM target than HubSpot/Salesforce.

services.name: Attio
services.description: Modern data-model CRM — flexible objects, lists, notes.

endpoints.description: Create a record on any object

services.notes: Popular with crypto-native teams. Cleaner schema for agents than legacy CRMs.

services.name: Google Calendar
services.description: Calendar events — list, create, update, free/busy.
services.notes: Required for Calendar / Booking Agent bundle.

services.name: Microsoft Graph
services.description: Outlook calendar/mail/contacts + Teams + Drive.

endpoints.description: Send mail as the signed-in user

services.notes: Enterprise calendar coverage. Needed alongside google-calendar.

services.name: Cal.com
services.description: Open-source scheduling — booking links, event types, availability.

endpoints.description: Create a booking against a Cal.com event type

services.notes: Self-hostable, agent-friendly scheduling layer.

services.name: Calendly
services.description: Scheduling — event types, scheduled events, invitees.
services.notes: Mainstream consumer/SMB scheduling counterpart to Cal.com.

services.name: Greenhouse
services.description: ATS — candidates, applications, interviews, scorecards.
services.notes: Required for ATS Recruiting Agent bundle.

services.name: Lever
services.description: ATS — candidates, opportunities, postings, feedback.

endpoints.description: Add a note on an opportunity

services.notes: Greenhouse alternative for ATS recruiting bundle.

services.name: Workable
services.description: ATS for SMB — jobs, candidates, stages, comments.
services.notes: SMB-tier ATS coverage.

services.name: LinkedIn Recruiter
services.description: Authenticated LinkedIn recruiter search, profiles, InMail.

endpoints.description: Search candidates via Recruiter System Connect

services.notes: LinkedIn Talent Solutions partner program access required. The mock recruiter bundle assumes this exists; today only `clado` partially covers it.

services.name: Shopify Admin API
services.description: E-commerce store management — products, orders, fulfillment, customers.

endpoints.description: Adjust inventory level for a variant

services.notes: Required for E-commerce Listing / Operations Agent bundle.

services.name: Amazon SP-API
services.description: Amazon Selling Partner API — listings, orders, FBA inventory, reports.

endpoints.description: Create or update a product listing
List orders within a date range

services.notes: AWS SigV4 signing + LWA OAuth — non-trivial to wrap. High value for sellers.

services.name: eBay
services.description: eBay Sell + Buy APIs — inventory, offers, orders, search.

endpoints.description: Create or replace an inventory item
Create an offer for an inventory item

services.notes: Secondary marketplace for E-commerce bundle.

services.name: Etsy
services.description: Etsy Open API — listings, shops, transactions.

endpoints.description: Create a listing in a shop

services.notes: Niche but useful for AI-generated craft/print E-commerce flows.

services.name: EasyPost
services.description: Multi-carrier shipping API — labels, tracking, rates across FedEx/UPS/USPS/DHL.

endpoints.description: Create a shipment and get rates
Create a tracker for a tracking code

services.notes: Required for Logistics / Shipping Tracker bundle. Single API across all major carriers.

services.name: Shippo
services.description: Multi-carrier shipping — rates, labels, tracking, returns.

endpoints.description: Purchase a shipping label from a chosen rate

services.notes: EasyPost alternative.

services.name: Zillow
services.description: Property listings, Zestimate, neighborhood data.
services.notes: Zillow's official API is gated; in practice wrap via Bridge Interactive or RapidAPI Zillow proxies.

services.name: Redfin
services.description: Listing search, property details, agent + price history.
services.notes: No public API — would need a scrape-based wrap. Lower priority than RapidAPI Zillow.

services.name: MLS Grid
services.description: Standardized RESO Web API access to MLS listing data across the US.
services.notes: Cleanest path to true MLS coverage. Per-MLS licensing required.

services.name: arXiv
services.description: Open-access preprint search — physics, math, CS, biology, economics.
services.notes: Free upstream — wrap fee covers parsing + rate-limit pooling.

services.name: Semantic Scholar
services.description: Academic graph — paper metadata, citations, references, embeddings.
services.notes: Required for Academic Research bundle.

services.name: PubMed (NCBI E-utilities)
services.description: Biomedical literature search and retrieval.
services.notes: Underpins Healthcare/Drug Research bundle and overlaps with Academic Research.

services.name: USPTO
services.description: US patent search — applications, grants, assignments.
services.notes: Required for Patent Search bundle.

services.name: Google Patents
services.description: Public patent search across 100+ patent offices.

endpoints.description: Patent search (no official public API; scrape-based wrap)

services.notes: Bigger international coverage than USPTO. No official API; wrap via SerpAPI Google Patents or scraping.

services.name: USAspending.gov
services.description: US federal contracts, grants, loans, agency budget data.

endpoints.description: Search awards by recipient, agency, location, date

services.notes: Required for Government / Public Records bundle.

services.name: CourtListener
services.description: Court opinions, oral arguments, RECAP federal court documents.
services.notes: PACER alternative with no per-page fees. Required for Government / Public Records bundle.

services.name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
services.description: IRS Form 990 filings for US nonprofits.
services.notes: Free upstream. Required for Government / Public Records bundle.

services.name: FEC
services.description: US Federal Election Commission — candidates, committees, filings, contributions.
services.notes: Free upstream. Useful for political-research bundles.

services.name: openFDA
services.description: Drug labels, adverse events, recalls, device 510(k), food enforcement.
services.notes: Required for Healthcare / Drug Research bundle.

services.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
services.description: US clinical trials registry — studies, conditions, locations, results.

endpoints.description: Search and retrieve clinical trial studies

services.notes: Required for Healthcare / Drug Research bundle.

services.name: The Odds API
services.description: Sportsbook odds across NFL, NBA, MLB, soccer, etc.

endpoints.description: Live odds for a sport across configured bookmakers

services.notes: Required for Sports Data / Betting bundle.

services.name: SportsData.io
services.description: Real-time stats, schedules, players, projections across major leagues.

endpoints.description: Games and scores for a date

services.notes: Stats/projections counterpart to The Odds API.

services.name: ESPN
services.description: Public ESPN scoreboard and stats endpoints.
services.notes: Unofficial but stable public endpoints. Free upstream — wrap fee is pure infra.

services.name: Google Maps Platform
services.description: Places, directions, geocoding, distance matrix, roads, time zones.
services.notes: The mock vacation-planner bundle assumes these exist via stableenrich.dev but they are not in services.json proper. Complements `mapbox`.

services.name: Google Cloud Vision
services.description: Image labels, OCR, faces, logos, landmarks, safe search.

endpoints.description: Annotate an image with selected feature types

services.notes: Cheaper and faster than GPT-4o vision for high-volume label/OCR/safe-search workloads.

services.name: AWS Rekognition
services.description: Image and video analysis — labels, faces, moderation, text, celebrities.

endpoints.description: Rekognition action via X-Amz-Target header (DetectLabels, DetectFaces, etc.)

services.notes: AWS SigV4 signing required. Strong on video moderation.

services.name: Clarifai
services.description: Pre-trained vision models — concepts, demographics, moderation, custom workflows.

endpoints.description: Run a model on an image or video URL

services.notes: Vision-API alternative with custom workflow chaining.

services.name: Persona
services.description: Identity verification — document scan, selfie liveness, database checks.

endpoints.description: Fetch inquiry status and extracted data

services.notes: Required for KYC + face-match identity flows.
